How we check

These files are read only on websites that answered the UCP pass. Poppy is /.well-known/poppy.json. It counts as published on HTTP 200 when the JSON is an object with a string protocol_version and an organization object (Personal Agent Protocol). HTTP 200 that fails that check counts as not found. An A2A agent card is /.well-known/agent-card.json or the earlier /.well-known/agent.json (A2A agent discovery). It counts as published on HTTP 200 when the JSON is an object with a string name and at least one of skills, supportedInterfaces, url or capabilities. If one of the two card paths is a refusal, that website is not treated as a no. A refusal is not "no". A store counts when at least one of its websites meets the rule. This page counts stores. The Beyond UCP table counts websites, so the two numbers can differ. How we check.
